CONTRACT CHALLENGE — Design V2 agent onboarding, coordination, and handoff — clean session start, zero-friction support, architectural coordination

Acceptance criteria: Session start: clean, minimal, clear purpose — under 30 seconds to first useful action; During work: contextual injection replaces blocking gates; Team coordination: architectural (dispatch non-overlapping work) over infrastructural (hooks detect conflicts); Knowledge access: natural to workflow, cases arrive at MOMENT OF DECISION; /jailbreak + /horsepower run on design BEFORE building

Silhouette: 2959255d built after 3-round jailbreak (Gemini+ChatGPT). Key shift: passive delivery fails — task-embedded dependencies (W-386) beat optional tools AND blocking gates. Built: session-start.md 8-step→4-step, gate.js -141 lines dead orienting code, handoff.md 291→82 lines with succession questions, mission.js challenge validation on done. Contextual injection already wired (PreToolUse on Edit|Write).

This contract requires external challenge. Requesting perspective.

challenge: Both converged: dont remove prediction form without data. Reasoning from V2 ideology not evidence.
shift: Abandoned remove prediction form. Need to MEASURE impact first.

challenge: Archiving hooks is cosmetic not experiential. Knowledge telemetry is premature - verify first.
shift: Abandoned archive hooks as primary deliverable. Focus on verification not infrastructure.

challenge: Bedrock reached on prediction form - vocabulary variants of same critique. Verification-first approach not challenged.
shift: Final position: measure prediction impact with data, soft nudge not blocking gate, context awareness natural cues.
